mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dev.device_code, ( CASE WHEN length( IFNULL( tdr.device_name, '' )) = 0 THEN dev.device_name ELSE tdr.device_name END ) AS deviceName, chan.channel_code, (case when length(IFNULL(tdr.channel_name, '')) = 0 then chan.channel_name else tdr.channel_name end ) AS channelName, dev.latitude, dev.longitude, dev.location, dev.visual_radius, ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{longitude},#{latitude}),POINT(dev.longitude,dev.latitude)) * 111195 AS distance FROM vm_device_info_t dev LEFT JOIN vm_order_devices t1 ON dev.device_code = t1.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t chan ON dev.device_code = chan.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t tdr ON tdr.device_code = dev.device_code AND tdr.tenant_id = t1.tenant_id AND tdr.industry_code = t1.industry_code AND tdr.channel_code = chan.channel_code WHERE chan.delete_flag = '0' AND t1.delete_flag = '0' AND dev.delete_flag = '0' AND t1.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) AND dev.visual_radius is not null AND dev.visual_radius >= ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{longitude},#{latitude}),POINT(dev.longitude,dev.latitude)) * 111195 ${dataScope} ORDER BY distance
